title: Explain a Technical Project
description: Explain a complex project, your decisions and its result.
scenario: You are speaking with a senior technical interviewer.
initial_question: Tell me about a complex software or AI project you worked on.
transfer_question: How would you explain the same project to a non-technical client?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Preserve valid technical terminology and focus on communication impact.
